key_concepts: A series circuit connects components sequentially in one path
Current is the same through all parts of a series circuit
Total voltage in a series circuit is the sum of individual voltages
Total resistance in a series circuit is the sum of individual resistances
Total resistance in a series circuit is greater than any individual resistance
Ohm's law relates voltage, current, and resistance as V = IR
Ammeters are connected in series to measure current
Voltmeters are connected across a component to measure voltage
Schematic diagrams use standard symbols for circuit components
Series circuits are simple in design and easy to troubleshoot
Adding resistors in series increases total resistance
